category_title: Primary students with low reading motivation who perceive a lack of autonomy and environmental discomfort
scenario_title: Highly structured reading intervention lacking student autonomy
minimal_context: The student is participating in a pullout reading intervention session where they are expected to complete phonics drills and read a leveled text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to start by doing our Wilson Fundations drills, and then we will read this new LLI book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Can we read one of my favorite books from home instead? There aren't much decisions for me to make here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to use the books I brought today. Let's start the drills.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's harder to read in here anyway because it's a little bit noisier than the classroom. I wish we had an insulated pod.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to focus on the drills right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing the sounds first. I'm going to sit in the comfy chair instead of these uncomfortable chairs. In the classroom the teacher doesn't stop us when we're reading to do spelling or to do sounds and stuff.
